mem_momucnxb_9c2678be6364.title: Research on open-source card battle RPG game projects for Warhammer/Blood Brothe
mem_momucnxb_9c2678be6364.content: Research on open-source card battle RPG game projects for Warhammer/Blood Brothers-inspired game. Key findings: Card-Forge/forge (MTG rules engine, GitHub, 73K+ commits, very active), Spellsource (open-source card battler, Java), OpenNetBattle (card battle engine in C++), godot-card-game-framework (db0/godot-card-game-framework), godot-open-rpg (turn-based RPG framework), boardgame.io (turn-based game engine in JS, 12K+ stars), CCG Kit for Unity (commercial asset), Single-Player CCG Kit for Unity, LibGDX (used by Slay the Spire), Godot Gameplay Systems addon, Godot Card Game Framework. Blood Brothers was a dark-fantasy card RPG by DeNA with auto-battle, card collection, team formation, and skill activation mechanics.
